gate: REH14 file b notes 1 and 2; offline unit checks, no runtime gate passed

cause: linkTx (intake-zip-layers.ts) writes the kept source on the member row; enrolMember then registers that source, which adds its own top-level item (registerIntakeItemTx, item_id = source id)
IntakeService.manifest returned every row, so the probed member row (no words after linkTx clears its reason) and the derived item both listed

Studio's trayItems hid every member row with a source, so the browser tray showed one row, but the GET intake list showed two; it also hid a member kept but not enrolled (ZIP_NESTING_LIMIT, an enrolment failure), which has no item of its own
fix: server rule listedIntakeRows (intake-ledger.ts), applied in manifest: a member row is left out only when its source has its own top-level item in the same read; every other member row stays with its own words

the item select joins the archive named by the source's zip-layer/1 lineage (inspection.archiveMember.parentSourceId); intakeItem prefixes 'Taken out of <archive name>.' for both the list and the one-item route
Studio drops trayItems and shows the rows the server lists
findings.why: a server rule, so the GET list, the tray and any other client agree

findings.note: 409 on the event stream and a lagging tray
findings.seen: REH14 dress-log: both 409s were GET /events?cursor=0 from the table page (useTableStream) at 'Open the table' on the ZIP member CSV; the case had more retained events than the replay bound (256), so the reader answered INGESTION_RESYNC replay_limit before headers
cause: useTableStream opened with ?cursor=0 (replay everything); EventSource closes for good on an HTTP refusal and 'Reconnect stream' reopened with the same refused cursor, so the page stayed on 2 s job polling and never re-read its profile or source case
a resync frame on the table stream closed it and waited for a press
case-subscription treated a 409 as a lost link: a 'disconnected' banner with the refusal words, and re-read only at the next 5 s silence tick

the tray's refresh invalidated with cancelRefetch false: a notification during a read in flight joined that read, whose snapshot predates the change, and was lost until the next notification; REH14 manifest reads took up to 37 s under load
fix: useTableStream: a refused open re-reads now and reopens at the head (no cursor); a resync reopens at its head cursor; both after resumeDelay 1, 2, 4, then at most 5 s, reset on open
case-subscription: a 409 re-reads every consumer now and reopens at the head after resumeDelay, without the disconnected banner
rereadQuery: a refresh during a read in flight asks for one more read after it
findings.authority: no server check changed; replay bound, cursor scope and resync rules are as before
